title: Fasting
summary: A fasting timer built for multi-day fasts.

stories.want: to see how long is left without opening the app
stories.soThat: I can get through the last hours

requirements.text: A fast's goal is one of `fasting.presets` or a custom length up to `fasting.max`.
On Android a running fast shows a sticky notification with a live countdown that keeps ticking while the app is killed.
On Android an exact alarm announces when the fast's goal is reached.
The fasting page shows lifetime records (longest fast, hours fasted, goals hit) and flags a new personal record as it happens.
A running fast shows which stage it has reached, by hours fasted.
